newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Crucible to float off units - paper.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Crucible to float off units - paper.

text.p: Industrial ceramics and specialty materials group Morgan Crucible Co Plc is expected to float several of its smaller engineering businesses to raise about 40 million stg, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
The flotation's proceeds will be used the strengthen the group's balance sheet ahead of a potentially large acquisition, it added.
Industry analysts told the newspaper they believed Morgan Crucible was gearing up for a big deal to boost its technical ceramics division.
The operations to be floated off are thought to include aerospace and defence subsidiaries such as MBM Technology and Laser Diode.
